# StudySmarter

> > StudySmarter is an AI-powered learning platform offering verified study materials, flashcards, and spaced repetition tools for students across school and university levels.

StudySmarter provides comprehensive study guides, explanations, and interactive learning resources across sciences, humanities, languages, and professional subjects. The platform combines intelligent learning algorithms with community-verified content to support GCSE, A-Level, and degree-level students.

## Key Topics

- Spaced Repetition
- Flashcards
- Study Guides
- Exam Preparation
- Learning Platform
- GCSE & A-Level
- English Literature
- Science Education
- Language Learning
- Educational Content
- Study Notes
- Explanations
- Learning Materials
- Mobile Learning (iOS/Android)
- Exam AI

## Core Platform

- [StudySmarter | The #1 learning app for university & school](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk): StudySmarter homepage: intelligent learning app with AI, spaced repetition, and mobile support
- [Explanations, Flashcards, Quizzes, and More - Free and Verified](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations): StudySmarter Originals: free verified study materials directory with explanations and flashcards

## Science & Mathematics

- [Biology: Revision Notes for A-level, GCSE, AP and More](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/biology): Biology revision notes for A-level and GCSE with flashcards and spaced repetition
- [Chemistry: Topics, Notes, Formula & Study Guide | StudySmarter](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/chemistry): Chemistry study guide covering organic, physical, inorganic topics and formulas
- [Combined Science: GCSE, Revision, Synergy, Trilogy & Flashcards](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/combined-science): GCSE Combined Science revision covering physics, biology, chemistry with flashcards
- [Environmental Science: Topics, Notes, Examples & Study Guide](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/environmental-science): Environmental Science study guide covering living world, climate change, and Earth

## English & Humanities

- [English Language: Topics, Notes, Examples & Study Guide](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/english): English Language study guide covering grammar, writing, reading, and speaking skills
- [English Literature: Topics, Notes, Examples & Study Guide](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/english-literature): English Literature guide covering novels, poetry, drama, fiction, and Shakespeare
- [Geography: Topics, Notes, Examples & Study Guide](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/geography): Geography study guide covering physical, environmental, human geography, and cultures
- [Anthropology: Examples, Definition & Cultural | StudySmarter](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/anthropology): Anthropology study guide with cultural examples, definitions, and flashcards
- [Archaeology: Examples, Definition, and Review | StudySmarter](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/archaeology): Archaeology learning resource with definitions, examples, and study materials

## Business, Technology & Professional Studies

- [Business Studies: Revision Notes & Exam Prep | StudySmarter](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/business-studies): Business Studies revision guide with notes, flashcards, and exam preparation tools

- [Economics: Topics, Notes, Examples & Study Guide](https://www.studysmarter.co.uk/explanations/economics): Economics study guide covering supply, demand, inflation, and scarcity concepts
